question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.

My stomach is so _______ (empty) I couldn't possibly eat more.
solution:
The correct answer is "**overfed**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Empty" means having nothing or nobody inside it. **(ख़ाली)

 
 
• Example: She carried an empty box with her.
 
 
 
• **"Overfed" means having eaten too much, which is the opposite of "empty".**(जरूरत से ज्यादा खाना)
 
 
• Example: He overfed the fish and they died.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, among the given options, the word "overfed" is the antonym of the word "empty".

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (teeming) means overflowing with or swarming with, which is not opposite to "empty".(भरा हुआ)
 
• Option 3 (flush) means having plenty of something, especially money, which is not opposite to "empty".(लालिमा)
 
• Option 4 (drained) means having no energy or feeling very tired, which is not opposite to "empty".(सूखा)
